主要内容: The document titled 'Fiscal Year 2020 Annual Report - SEC.gov' was filed on July 13, 2020, by Alibaba Group Holding Limited, a foreign private issuer. The report is submitted under Form 6-K, which is used for reporting to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing includes an exhibit, Exhibit 99.1, which is the Hong Kong Annual Report for the fiscal year 2020. The report was signed by Timothy A. Steinert, who holds the title of Company Secretary. This filing is part of the regulatory process for foreign private issuers in the United States, and it reflects the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
